Featured Project

Café App UI/UX Design

A café app design concept focused on presenting café items through a simple and visually appealing interface. KatCafe lets a customer browse the menu, add items, review an order and find the café, in seven connected screens.

Tools FigmaType Personal design projectScreens 7Status In progress · prototype next

Consistent navigation

The same four-tab bottom bar appears on every screen, so users always know where they are.

One reusable card

Coffee, momos, waffles and brownies all use the same menu card, which keeps browsing predictable.

Warm identity

A cream, sand and caramel palette with soft circles gives the app a cosy café feel.

Clear order flow

Add an item, review quantities and totals, then proceed to checkout without extra steps.

The screens

From first look to checkout

Home→Browse menu→Review order→Contact the café
